summary: Calls ArithmeticComparison_0f55(this), then conditionally calls FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) when bit 0 of argument a2 is set; returns this. Conditional teardown helper called from DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation (0x00502A15).

local_names.this: object passed to the comparison and, conditionally, to the free wrapper; also the return value
local_names.a2: flag byte whose bit 0 gates the free-wrapper call

operations.description: Call ArithmeticComparison_0f55((int)this) before the conditional free.
If (a2 & 1) != 0, the free-wrapper branch runs; otherwise it is skipped.
When bit 0 of a2 is set, call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this).

unresolved: Meaning of the a2 bit-0 flag and the purpose of the ArithmeticComparison_0f55 call on 'this' are not evidenced.
The ABI lead names this a destructor-style conditional free (LEGACY), but no existing analysis corroborates it.
Owner class of 'this' is not evidenced.
